name: novel-management
description: 小说管理系统 —— 根目录脚本。只管拉起下面五个子项目，自己不包含任何业务代码

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix reader-web install && npm --prefix author-web install && npm --prefix admin-web install && npm --prefix dev-proxy install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n reader,author,admin,proxy -c cyan,magenta,yellow,green "npm --prefix reader-web run dev" "npm --prefix author-web run dev" "npm --prefix admin-web run dev" "npm --prefix dev-proxy run dev"
scripts.dev:author: npm --prefix author-web run dev
scripts.dev:gateway: mvn -f backend/pom.xml -DskipTests -pl novel-gateway -am package && cd backend && java -jar novel-gateway/target/novel-gateway.jar
scripts.dev:auth: mvn -f backend/pom.xml -DskipTests -pl novel-auth -am package && cd backend && java -jar novel-auth/target/novel-auth.jar
scripts.dev:backend: mvn -f backend/pom.xml -DskipTests -pl novel-backend -am package && cd backend && java -jar novel-backend/target/novel-backend.jar
scripts.build: npm --prefix reader-web run build && npm --prefix author-web run build && npm --prefix admin-web run build
scripts.build:author: npm --prefix author-web run build
